name: ferriheme
description: Any iron(III)-porphyrin coordination complex. The differentia is the +3 oxidation state of the iron. This cannot be read from a SMILES string (ChEBI draws ferriheme b with a formally Fe(+1) centre), and it is not a molecule-level property, so no current grouping meta-pattern can define this class. Members state it on their iron AtomOccurrence via oxidation_number.
